description: This file defines the KamonGauge class, an implementation of the Gauge interface, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve gauge metrics using the Kamon monitoring library.

classes.name: KamonGauge
classes.description: An immutable class implementing Gauge, providing methods to create, modify, and retrieve gauge metrics with tagging support.

methods.name: newGauge
methods.description: Creates a new KamonGauge instance with the specified name and no tags.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the gauge value by one.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Decrements the gauge value by one.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the gauge to a specific Long value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the gauge, if possible.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new Gauge instance with an additional tag key-value pair.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new Gauge instance with multiple tags added.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns all tags associated with the gauge.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the gauge value to zero.

methods.name: getKamonInternalGauge
methods.description: Internal method to get the Kamon gauge object with current tags.
